f.title: Definition: adverse event in a clinical trial
f.statement: An adverse event (AE) is any untoward medical occurrence in a patient or clinical trial participant administered a pharmaceutical product, not necessarily causally related to the treatment; it may be any unfavourable and unintended sign, symptom or disease, including results outside the reference range, associated with use of an investigational product, whether or not related to it.
f.clause: Chapter I Section III, Art. 6 XXIII (Definitions)
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. Defines the adverse events the sponsor must monitor (Art. 55) and the investigator must report to the sponsor (Art. 61).
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: XXIII- Evento Adverso (EA) - qualquer ocorrência médica adversa em um paciente ouparticipante do ensaio clínico a quem um produto farmacêutico foi administrado e quenão necessariamente tenha uma relação causal ao tratamento. Como resultado, um EA podeser qualquer sinal, sintoma, ou doença desfavorável e não intencional (incluindoresultados fora da faixa de referência), associada com o uso de um produto sobinvestigação, quer seja relacionada a ele ou não;
rows.location: Chapter I Section III, Art. 6 XXIII (Definitions)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; definition with no modal verb; quote has words joined at line ends in the captured text. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: XXIII - Adverse Event (AE): any untoward medical occurrence in a patient or clinical trial participant to whom a pharmaceutical product was administered and which does not necessarily have a causal relationship with the treatment. As a result, an AE may be any unfavourable and unintended sign, symptom or disease (including results outside the reference range), associated with the use of an investigational product, whether or not related to it;

f.title: Definition: serious adverse event and unexpected adverse event in a clinical trial
f.statement: A serious adverse event is one resulting in any adverse experience with medicines, biological products or devices, at any dose, with any of these outcomes: death; threat to life; persistent or significant incapacity/disability; requiring or prolonging hospitalisation; congenital anomaly or birth defect; any suspected transmission of an infectious agent through a medicine; or a clinically significant event. An unexpected adverse event is an event not described as an adverse reaction in the investigational medicinal product brochure or the package leaflet.
f.clause: Chapter I Section III, Art. 6 XXIV-XXV (Definitions)
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. Sets the seriousness and expectedness criteria for SUSAR notification to Anvisa (Arts. 63, 66, 67) and the investigator's 24-hour SAE reporting (Art. 65).

rows.location: Chapter I Section III, Art. 6 XXIV-XXV (Definitions)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; definition with no modal verb; quote has words joined at line ends in the captured text. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
XXIV - Serious Adverse Event: one that results in any adverse experience with medicines, biological products or devices, occurring at any dose, and resulting in any of the following outcomes: a) death; b) threat to life; c) persistent or significant incapacity/disability; d) requires hospitalisation or prolongs hospitalisation; e) congenital anomaly or birth defect; f) any suspected transmission of an infectious agent through a medicine or; g) clinically significant event.
XXV - Unexpected Adverse Event: event not described as an adverse reaction in the investigational medicinal product brochure or in the package leaflet.

f.title: Archive clinical trial data for 5 years after the last registration approval (2 years if development stops)
f.statement: The sponsor must keep clinical trial data on file, physical or digital, for 5 years after the last approval of a registration application in Brazil. If clinical development is discontinued, or concluded without a registration application, the sponsor must keep the data on file for at least 2 years after the discontinuation or formal conclusion of development.
f.clause: Chapter II Section I, Art. 11
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. Clinical trial data, including safety data.
f.exceptions: Development discontinued or concluded without a registration application: at least 2 years.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.deadline: 5 years after the last registration approval in Brazil; at least 2 years after discontinuation or formal conclusion without a registration application
rows.quote:
Art. 11. O patrocinador deve manter os dados do ensaio clínico em arquivo, físico oudigital, por um período de 5 (cinco) anos após a última aprovação de umasolicitação de registro no Brasil.
 Parágrafo único. Em caso de descontinuação do desenvolvimento clínico ou de suaconclusão não seguida de pedido de registro, o patrocinador deve manter os dados doensaio clínico em arquivo físico ou digital, por pelo menos 2 (dois) anos após adescontinuação do desenvolvimento clínico ou conclusão formal deste desenvolvimento.
rows.location: Chapter II Section I, Art. 11
rows.review_note: Review: added (missed record-retention duty covering trial safety data). Re-translation: own translation used for quote_en. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; reviewer-added row; independently re-translated here and quote_en agrees; "deve manter" = Mandatory; 5 and 2 years correct. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 11. The sponsor must keep the clinical trial data on file, physical or digital, for a period of 5 (five) years after the last approval of a registration application in Brazil.
Sole paragraph. In the case of discontinuation of clinical development or of its conclusion not followed by a registration application, the sponsor must keep the clinical trial data on file, physical or digital, for at least 2 (two) years after the discontinuation of clinical development or the formal conclusion of this development.

f.title: Sponsor pays for diagnosis, treatment and hospitalisation needed to resolve trial adverse events
f.statement: The sponsor is responsible for all expenses for procedures and examinations, especially diagnosis, treatment and hospitalisation of the trial participant, and other actions needed to resolve adverse events related to the clinical trial.
f.clause: Chapter II Section I, Art. 12

rows.quote: Art. 12. O patrocinador é responsável por todas as despesas relacionadas comprocedimentos e exames, especialmente aquelas de diagnóstico, tratamento e internaçãodo participante do ensaio clínico, e outras ações necessárias para a resolução deeventos adversos relativos ao ensaio clínico.
rows.location: Chapter II Section I, Art. 12
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "é responsável" is a responsibility statement, not a modal verb. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 12. The sponsor is responsible for all expenses related to procedures and examinations, especially those of diagnosis, treatment and hospitalisation of the clinical trial participant, and other actions necessary for the resolution of adverse events related to the clinical trial.

f.title: Ensure safety and efficacy data support the proposed human exposure
f.statement: The sponsor must ensure that the safety and efficacy data obtained for the investigational medicinal product are sufficient to support human exposure by the proposed route, at the chosen dose, for the proposed treatment duration and in the population to be studied.
f.clause: Chapter II Section I, Art. 13

rows.quote: Art. 13. O patrocinador deve assegurar que os dados obtidos sobre segurança eeficácia do medicamento experimental são suficientes para apoiar a exposição humanapela via de administração proposta, pela dosagem escolhida, pela duração do tratamentoproposto e na população a ser estudada.
rows.location: Chapter II Section I, Art. 13
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve assegurar" = Mandatory; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 13. The sponsor must ensure that the data obtained on the safety and efficacy of the investigational medicinal product are sufficient to support human exposure by the proposed route of administration, at the chosen dosage, for the proposed duration of treatment and in the population to be studied.

f.title: Inform those involved immediately when a trial is terminated early or suspended
f.statement: The sponsor must immediately inform those involved in the trial when it is terminated prematurely or suspended for any reason.
f.clause: Chapter II Section I, Art. 19

rows.quote: Art. 19. O patrocinador deve informar imediatamente os envolvidos no ensaio, quandoeste for finalizado prematuramente ou suspenso por qualquer motivo.
rows.location: Chapter II Section I, Art. 19
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 19. The sponsor must immediately inform those involved in the trial when it is terminated prematurely or suspended for any reason.

f.title: Sponsor may transfer functions to a CRO (ORPC) but keeps final responsibility; transfers in a signed document
f.statement: The sponsor may transfer its functions to a clinical research representative organisation (ORPC). The transfer does not remove the sponsor's final responsibility for the quality and integrity of the clinical trial data, and any trial functions transferred to and assumed by an ORPC must be specified in writing in a document signed by the sponsor and the ORPC.
f.clause: Chapter II Section I, Art. 20
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. Outsourcing of sponsor functions, including safety reporting, to an ORPC.
f.processes: Partner & vendor oversight; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.quote:
Art. 20. O patrocinador pode transferir suas funções para uma ORPC.
 §1º A transferência de que trata o caput não afasta a responsabilidade definitivado patrocinador pela qualidade e integridade dos dados do ensaio clínico.
 §2º Quaisquer funções relacionadas ao ensaio clínico que sejam transferidas a umaORPC e assumidas por esta devem ser especificadas por escrito em documento assinado pelopatrocinador e ORPC.
rows.location: Chapter II Section I, Art. 20

Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 20. The sponsor may transfer its functions to an ORPC.
§ 1 The transfer referred to in the caput does not remove the final responsibility of the sponsor for the quality and integrity of the clinical trial data.
§ 2 Any functions related to the clinical trial that are transferred to an ORPC and assumed by it must be specified in writing in a document signed by the sponsor and the ORPC.

f.title: Investigator ensures medical care for trial adverse events at no cost to participants
f.statement: The investigator must ensure adequate medical care for trial participants for any adverse events related to the trial, including clinically significant laboratory values, at no cost to the participant.
f.clause: Chapter II Section II, Art. 24

rows.quote: Art. 24. O investigador deve assegurar a assistência médica adequada aosparticipantes do ensaio clínico quanto a quaisquer eventos adversos relativos ao ensaioclínico, incluindo valores laboratoriais clinicamente significativos, sem qualquer ônuspara o participante.
rows.location: Chapter II Section II, Art. 24
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve assegurar" = Mandatory; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 24. The investigator must ensure adequate medical care for clinical trial participants with regard to any adverse events related to the clinical trial, including clinically significant laboratory values, without any cost to the participant.

f.title: Investigator informs participants of early termination or suspension and ensures therapy and follow-up
f.statement: The investigator must promptly inform trial participants when the trial is terminated prematurely or suspended for any reason, and ensure appropriate therapy and follow-up for participants.
f.clause: Chapter II Section II, Art. 25

rows.quote: Art. 25. O investigador deve informar prontamente os participantes do ensaio clínicoquando este for finalizado prematuramente ou suspenso por qualquer motivo, além deassegurar terapia apropriada e acompanhamento aos participantes.
rows.location: Chapter II Section II, Art. 25
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve informar prontamente" = Mandatory; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 25. The investigator must promptly inform the clinical trial participants when the trial is terminated prematurely or suspended for any reason, as well as ensure appropriate therapy and follow-up for the participants.

f.title: Primary sponsor of investigator-sponsored trials must have an adverse event management unit
f.statement: Where a trial is run by an investigator-sponsor, the primary sponsor (the affiliated institution) must have its own or outsourced structure with at least units for adverse event management, project management, data management, training, information technology, quality assurance and monitoring.
f.clause: Chapter II Section III, Art. 27 §4
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. Clinical trials carried out by an investigator-sponsor (Art. 27).

rows.location: Chapter II Section III, Art. 27 §4

Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.

f.title: Include prior human safety experience and any safety-related withdrawals in the DDCM
f.statement: The DDCM submitted to Anvisa must include a summary of safety aspects from previous human experience with the investigational product (e.g. expanded access and compassionate use) and post-marketing experience in other countries, if applicable; and information on any interruption of development or market withdrawal in any country for safety reasons or lack of efficacy, identifying the countries and the reasons.
f.clause: Chapter III Section II, Art. 38 V-VI
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. Content of the Clinical Drug Development Dossier (DDCM) submitted to Anvisa (Art. 38).

rows.location: Chapter III Section II, Art. 38 V-VI

f.title: File trial start and end date forms in Brazil within 30 calendar days
f.statement: Forms giving the clinical trial start and end dates in Brazil must be filed as a secondary petition to the corresponding clinical trial dossier process within 30 calendar days after each start and end date.
f.clause: Chapter III Section II, Art. 40
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. The start date in Brazil is the anniversary reference for the annual protocol report (Art. 68 §2).

rows.deadline: Within 30 calendar days after each start date and each end date in Brazil
rows.quote: Art. 40. Formulários de data de início e término do ensaio clínico no Brasildeverão ser protocolizados na forma de petição secundária ao processo do dossiê deensaio clínico correspondente, em até 30 (trinta) dias corridos após cada data deinício e término.
rows.location: Chapter III Section II, Art. 40
data_elements: clinical trial start date in Brazil
clinical trial end date in Brazil

Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; reviewer-added row; independently re-translated here and quote_en agrees; "deverão ser protocolizados" passive, actor inferred; 30 calendar days correct. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 40. Forms for the start and end dates of the clinical trial in Brazil shall be filed as a secondary petition to the process of the corresponding clinical trial dossier, within up to 30 (thirty) calendar days after each start and end date.

f.title: Notify DDCM changes arising from authority safety recommendations or alerts before implementing
f.statement: Modifications to the DDCM arising from recommendations or alerts issued by health authorities shall be notified before they are implemented, and may be carried out without waiting for Anvisa's prior opinion.
f.clause: Chapter IV, Art. 44
f.exceptions: No need to wait for Anvisa's prior opinion before implementing.

rows.quote: Art. 44. As modificações ao DDCM oriundas de recomendações ou alertas emitidos porautoridades sanitárias deverão ser notificadas antes de serem implementadas e poderãoser executadas, independente da manifestação prévia da Anvisa.
rows.location: Chapter IV, Art. 44

Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 44. Modifications to the DDCM arising from recommendations or alerts issued by health authorities shall be notified before they are implemented and may be carried out regardless of Anvisa's prior opinion.

f.title: Report non-substantial DDCM modifications in the DSUR
f.statement: Modifications to the DDCM that are not substantial must be presented to Anvisa as part of the Development Safety Update Report (DSUR) of the investigational medicinal product.
f.clause: Chapter IV, Art. 45

rows.quote: Art. 45. As modificações ao DDCM não consideradas substanciais devem serapresentadas à Anvisa como parte do Relatório de atualização de segurança dodesenvolvimento do medicamento experimental.
rows.location: Chapter IV, Art. 45
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "devem ser apresentadas à Anvisa" passive, actor inferred. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 45. Modifications to the DDCM not considered substantial must be presented to Anvisa as part of the Development Safety Update Report of the investigational medicinal product.

f.title: Urgent safety amendments may be implemented at once and notified to Anvisa immediately
f.statement: Protocol amendments intended to eliminate immediate risks to participant safety are exempt from the Art. 47 caput duty to await Anvisa's opinion; the text says these amendments may be implemented and notified to Anvisa immediately.
f.clause: Chapter V, Art. 47 §3
f.exceptions: Exception to the Art. 47 caput duty to await Anvisa's opinion on substantial amendments.

rows.quote: §3º Excetuam-se do disposto no caput as emendas que visam eliminar riscos imediatos à segurança dos participantes do ensaio clínico. Estas poderão ser implementadas e notificadas à Anvisa imediatamente.
rows.location: Chapter V, Art. 47 §3
rows.review_note: Review: statement said the amendment "must be notified" immediately; the source modal is "poderão ser implementadas e notificadas à Anvisa imediatamente" (may be implemented and notified immediately), so the statement now follows the quote. Level Permitted unchanged. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "poderão ser implementadas e notificadas" = Permitted; passive, actor inferred. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: § 3 Excepted from the caput are amendments intended to eliminate immediate risks to the safety of clinical trial participants. These may be implemented and notified to Anvisa immediately.

f.title: Sponsor may cancel or suspend a DDCM or trial with justification and a participant follow-up plan
f.statement: The sponsor may cancel or suspend a DDCM or clinical trial at any time, provided it sends technical-scientific justifications and a follow-up plan for participants in trials already started. Once a DDCM is cancelled, no related trial may continue in Brazil.
f.clause: Chapter VI, Art. 50 caput and §1

rows.quote:
Art. 50. O patrocinador pode cancelar ou suspender um DDCM ou ensaio clínico aqualquer momento, desde que encaminhadas as devidas justificativas técnico-científicas,bem como um plano de acompanhamento dos participantes do(s) ensaio(s) clínico(s) jáiniciado(s).
 §1º Uma vez cancelado um DDCM, nenhum ensaio clínico, relacionado a ele, poderá sercontinuado no País.
rows.location: Chapter VI, Art. 50 caput and §1
rows.review_note: Review: no change; caput "pode cancelar ou suspender" = Permitted, conditional on justification and participant follow-up plan; §1 consequence kept. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "pode cancelar ou suspender" = Permitted; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 50. The sponsor may cancel or suspend a DDCM or clinical trial at any time, provided that the appropriate technical-scientific justifications are sent, as well as a plan for follow-up of the participants of the clinical trial(s) already started.
§ 1 Once a DDCM is cancelled, no clinical trial related to it may be continued in the country.

f.title: Justify safety-driven cancellations and present risk-minimisation measures for participants
f.statement: If a DDCM or clinical trial is cancelled for safety reasons, the sponsor must justify the reasons technically and scientifically and present the measures to minimise/mitigate risk to the trial participants.
f.clause: Chapter VI, Art. 50 §2
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. Cancellation of a DDCM or clinical trial for safety reasons.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Risk management & minimisation

rows.quote: §2º Caso um DDCM ou ensaio clínico seja cancelado por motivos de segurança, opatrocinador deve justificar técnica e cientificamente as razões para o cancelamento eapresentar as medidas para minimização/mitigação de risco aos participantes do(s)ensaio(s) clínico(s).
rows.location: Chapter VI, Art. 50 §2
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: § 2 If a DDCM or clinical trial is cancelled for safety reasons, the sponsor must justify technically and scientifically the reasons for the cancellation and present the measures for minimisation/mitigation of risk to the participants of the clinical trial(s).

f.title: Notify Anvisa of a suspension or cancellation within 15 calendar days of the decision
f.statement: Suspensions and cancellations of a clinical trial or DDCM must be submitted to Anvisa as a secondary petition attached to the respective process. The sponsor must notify Anvisa of the decision to suspend or cancel a clinical trial or DDCM within a maximum of 15 calendar days after the decision.
f.clause: Chapter VI, Art. 50 §3 and Art. 51
f.exceptions: Temporary suspension as an immediate safety measure: 7 calendar days (Art. 52).

rows.deadline: Within 15 calendar days after the decision to suspend or cancel
rows.quote:
§3º As suspensões e cancelamentos de ensaio clínico ou de DDCM devem ser submetidasà Anvisa na forma de petição secundária anexada ao respectivo processo.
 Art. 51. O patrocinador deve notificar à Anvisa sobre a decisão de suspender oucancelar um ensaio clínico ou DDCM. Após decisão de suspensão ou cancelamento, opatrocinador deve notificar à Anvisa no prazo máximo de 15 (quinze) dias corridos.
rows.location: Chapter VI, Art. 50 §3 and Art. 51
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve notificar ... 15 dias corridos" = Mandatory; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
§ 3 Suspensions and cancellations of a clinical trial or DDCM must be submitted to Anvisa as a secondary petition attached to the respective process.
Art. 51. The sponsor must notify Anvisa of the decision to suspend or cancel a clinical trial or DDCM. After the decision to suspend or cancel, the sponsor must notify Anvisa within a maximum of 15 (fifteen) calendar days.

f.title: Notify Anvisa within 7 calendar days of a temporary suspension for immediate safety reasons
f.statement: When a clinical trial or DDCM is temporarily suspended as an immediate safety measure, the sponsor must notify Anvisa within 7 calendar days from the date of suspension, giving the reasons. The notification must clearly explain the reasons, scope, interruption of treatment and suspension of participant recruitment.
f.clause: Chapter VI, Art. 52
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. Temporary suspension of a clinical trial or DDCM as an immediate safety measure.

rows.deadline: Within 7 calendar days from the date of suspension
rows.quote:
Art. 52. Nos casos de suspensão temporária do ensaio clínico ou DDCM como medidaimediata de segurança, o patrocinador deve notificar à Anvisa no prazo de 7 (sete) diascorridos a contar da data de suspensão, justificando os motivos.
 Parágrafo único. As razões, a abrangência, a interrupção do tratamento e asuspensão do recrutamento de participantes devem estar explicadas com clareza nanotificação de suspensão temporária.
rows.location: Chapter VI, Art. 52
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve notificar ... 7 dias corridos" = Mandatory; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 52. In cases of temporary suspension of the clinical trial or DDCM as an immediate safety measure, the sponsor must notify Anvisa within 7 (seven) calendar days from the date of suspension, justifying the reasons.
Sole paragraph. The reasons, the scope, the interruption of treatment and the suspension of recruitment of participants must be clearly explained in the temporary suspension notification.

f.title: Request Anvisa approval before restarting a suspended trial or DDCM
f.statement: Requests to reactivate suspended clinical trial protocols or DDCMs must be sent to Anvisa with justifications; the trial(s) or DDCM may restart only after Anvisa approval.
f.clause: Chapter VI, Art. 53

rows.quote:
Art. 53. As solicitações de reativação de protocolos de ensaios clínicos ou DDCMsuspensos devem ser encaminhadas à Anvisa acompanhadas das devidas justificativas paraque o(s) ensaio(s) possa( m) ser reiniciado(s).
 Parágrafo único. O(s) ensaio(s) clínico(s) ou DDCM poderá( ão) ser reiniciado(s)somente após aprovação pela Anvisa.
rows.location: Chapter VI, Art. 53
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "devem ser encaminhadas" passive, actor inferred. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 53. Requests for reactivation of suspended clinical trial protocols or DDCMs must be sent to Anvisa accompanied by the appropriate justifications so that the trial(s) can be restarted.
Sole paragraph. The clinical trial(s) or DDCM may be restarted only after approval by Anvisa.

f.title: Anvisa may cancel or suspend a DDCM or trial for safety or efficacy reports
f.statement: Anvisa may at any time cancel or suspend the DDCM or any linked clinical trial if it considers the approval conditions are not met or if safety or efficacy reports significantly affect trial participants or the scientific validity of the data, informing the sponsor of the reasons.
f.clause: Chapter VI, Art. 54

rows.quote: Art. 54. A Anvisa poderá, a qualquer momento, cancelar ou suspender o DDCM ou qualquerensaio clínico vinculado, se julgar que as condições de aprovação não foramatendidas ou se houver relatos de segurança ou eficácia que afetem significativamente osparticipantes do ensaio clínico ou afetem a validade científica de dados obtidos,informando os motivos ao patrocinador.
rows.location: Chapter VI, Art. 54
rows.review_note: Review: no change; authority power ("A Anvisa poderá") kept as Permitted with actor Anvisa. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; authority-only power ("A Anvisa poderá"). Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 54. Anvisa may, at any time, cancel or suspend the DDCM or any linked clinical trial if it considers that the conditions of approval have not been met or if there are safety or efficacy reports that significantly affect the clinical trial participants or affect the scientific validity of the data obtained, informing the sponsor of the reasons.

f.title: Monitor all adverse events, including non-serious ones, throughout development
f.statement: The sponsor must monitor all adverse events, including non-serious adverse events, during the development of the investigational medicinal product.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I, Art. 55
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Art. 55. O patrocinador deve monitorar todos os eventos adversos, inclusive os eventosadversos não graves, durante o desenvolvimento do medicamento experimental.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I, Art. 55
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve monitorar" = Mandatory; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 55. The sponsor must monitor all adverse events, including non-serious adverse events, during the development of the investigational medicinal product.

f.title: Systematically evaluate aggregate trial AE data and submit results in the DSUR
f.statement: The sponsor or the Independent Data Safety Monitoring Committee must systematically collect and evaluate aggregate data on adverse events occurring in the clinical trial and submit the results to Anvisa in the Development Safety Update Report (DSUR).
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I, Art. 56
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Aggregate reporting; Signal detection

rows.actor: Sponsor (patrocinador) or Independent Data Safety Monitoring Committee
rows.quote: Art. 56. O patrocinador ou Comitê Independente de Monitoramento de Segurança devecoletar e avaliar sistematicamente dados agregados de eventos adversos ocorridos no ensaioclínico, submetendo os resultados desta avaliação à Anvisa no relatório deatualização de segurança do desenvolvimento do medicamento experimental.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I, Art. 56
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; operative verb joined in the captured text ("devecoletar"); alternative actor (sponsor or committee). Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 56. The sponsor or the Independent Data Safety Monitoring Committee must systematically collect and evaluate aggregate data on adverse events occurring in the clinical trial, submitting the results of this evaluation to Anvisa in the Development Safety Update Report of the investigational medicinal product.

f.title: Establish a plan to detect late adverse events, justifying the period
f.statement: The sponsor must establish a monitoring plan for the detection of late adverse events, justifying the proposed period.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I, Art. 57 caput
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Risk management & minimisation

rows.quote: Art. 57. O patrocinador deve estabelecer um plano de monitoramento para detecção deeventos adversos tardios, justificando o período proposto.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I, Art. 57 caput
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve estabelecer" = Mandatory; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 57. The sponsor must establish a monitoring plan for the detection of late adverse events, justifying the proposed period.

f.title: Follow up mother and child in case of pregnancy
f.statement: In the case of pregnancy, the investigator and the sponsor must follow up the mother and the child.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I, Art. 57 sole paragraph
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Parágrafo único. No caso de gravidez, o investigador e o patrocinador devemacompanhar a mãe e o filho.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I, Art. 57 sole paragraph
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; operative verb joined in the captured text ("devemacompanhar"). Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Sole paragraph. In the case of pregnancy, the investigator and the sponsor must follow up the mother and the child.

f.title: Take immediate safety measures after a serious adverse event
f.statement: When a serious adverse event occurs during the conduct of a clinical trial in any phase, the sponsor and the investigator must adopt immediate safety measures to protect trial participants against any imminent risk.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I Subsection I, Art. 58 caput
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Risk management & minimisation

rows.quote: Art. 58. No caso de evento adverso grave ocorrido durante a condução do ensaioclínico em qualquer fase de desenvolvimento do medicamento, o patrocinador e oinvestigador devem adotar medidas imediatas de segurança para proteger os participantesdo ensaio clínico contra qualquer risco iminente.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I Subsection I, Art. 58 caput
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "devem adotar medidas imediatas" = Mandatory; actors explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 58. In the case of a serious adverse event occurring during the conduct of the clinical trial in any phase of development of the medicine, the sponsor and the investigator must adopt immediate safety measures to protect the clinical trial participants against any imminent risk.

f.title: Include measures taken, action plan and traceability data in SAE notifications
f.statement: When a serious adverse event is to be notified, the notification must state the measures adopted, the action plan should new events of the same nature occur, and data on the place where care was provided, together with the other data requested in the notification form, especially those enabling traceability of the event and the affected participant.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I Subsection I, Art. 58 sole paragraph
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Submission operations; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.quote: Parágrafo único. No caso de evento adverso grave a ser notificado, será necessárioinformar quais medidas foram adotadas, o plano de ação na ocorrência de novos eventosde mesma natureza, dados do local onde houve o atendimento, juntamente com outros dadosrequisitados no formulário para notificação, especialmente aqueles que possibilitem arastreabilidade do evento e do participante acometido.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I Subsection I, Art. 58 sole paragraph
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "será necessário informar" read as Mandatory (judgement); actor inferred; operative words joined in the captured text. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Sole paragraph. In the case of a serious adverse event to be notified, it will be necessary to state what measures were adopted, the action plan in the event of new events of the same nature, data on the place where care was provided, together with other data requested in the notification form, especially those that enable traceability of the event and of the affected participant.

f.title: SUSAR notification does not depend on IB, amendment, report or early-termination submissions
f.statement: Notification of unexpected serious adverse events whose causality is possible, probable or definite is independent of the submission of the Investigator's Brochure, amendments, reports or early termination of the clinical trial.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I Subsection I, Art. 59

rows.quote: Art. 59. A notificação de eventos adversos graves inesperados, cuja causalidade sejapossível, provável ou definida, independe da submissão de Brochura do Investigador,emendas, relatórios ou término precoce do ensaio clínico.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I Subsection I, Art. 59
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; no modal verb ("independe"); Mandatory by implication. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 59. Notification of unexpected serious adverse events whose causality is possible, probable or definite is independent of the submission of the Investigator's Brochure, amendments, reports or early termination of the clinical trial.

f.title: Phase III trials need an independent DSMB whose recommendations are reported to Anvisa
f.statement: Phase III clinical trial development must be accompanied by Independent Data Safety Monitoring Committees, and the sponsor must report their recommendations to Anvisa. If no such committee is constituted, justifications must be presented.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I Subsection I, Art. 60
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. Phase III clinical trials.
f.exceptions: Where no committee is constituted, justifications must be presented instead.

rows.quote:
Art. 60. O desenvolvimento de ensaio clínico fase III deve ser acompanhado porComitês Independentes de Monitoramento de Segurança e suas recomendações devem serreportadas à Anvisa pelo patrocinador.
 Parágrafo único. Nos casos em que não haja constituição de Comitês Independentesde Monitoramento de Segurança devem ser apresentadas justificativas.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I Subsection I, Art. 60
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve ser acompanhado"/"devem ser reportadas ... pelo patrocinador" = Mandatory; partly passive. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 60. The development of a phase III clinical trial must be accompanied by Independent Data Safety Monitoring Committees and their recommendations must be reported to Anvisa by the sponsor.
Sole paragraph. In cases where no Independent Data Safety Monitoring Committees are constituted, justifications must be presented.

f.title: Investigator reports all adverse events to the sponsor with a causality opinion
f.statement: The investigator must communicate all adverse events to the sponsor, provide any information requested and give an opinion on causality between the event and the investigational product. Adverse events or laboratory abnormalities affecting participant safety must be reported to the sponsor in accordance with GCP and the protocol.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I Subsection II, Art. 61
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote:
Art. 61. O investigador deve comunicar a ocorrência de todos os eventos adversos aopatrocinador, devendo fornecer qualquer informação requisitada e manifestar sua opiniãoem relação à causalidade entre o evento adverso e o produto sob investigação.
 Parágrafo único. Os eventos adversos ou anormalidades em resultados de exameslaboratoriais que afetem a segurança dos participantes devem ser relatados aopatrocinador de acordo com as BPC e o protocolo.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I Subsection II, Art. 61
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve comunicar" = Mandatory; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 61. The investigator must communicate the occurrence of all adverse events to the sponsor, providing any information requested and giving his or her opinion on the causality between the adverse event and the investigational product.
Sole paragraph. Adverse events or abnormalities in laboratory test results that affect the safety of participants must be reported to the sponsor in accordance with GCP and the protocol.

f.title: Treat all adverse events and follow participants until resolution or stabilisation
f.statement: All adverse events must be treated, and affected participants followed up by the principal investigator and team until resolution or stabilisation.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I Subsection II, Art. 62

rows.quote: Art. 62. Todos os eventos adversos devem ser tratados e os participantes acometidosacompanhados pelo investigador principal e sua equipe até sua resolução ouestabilização.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I Subsection II, Art. 62
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "devem ser tratados" passive; investigator named for follow-up. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 62. All adverse events must be treated and the affected participants followed up by the principal investigator and his or her team until their resolution or stabilisation.

f.title: Notify Anvisa of SUSARs occurring in Brazil via the specific electronic form
f.statement: The sponsor must notify Anvisa, through the specific electronic form, of unexpected serious adverse events occurring in Brazil whose causality in relation to the investigational product is possible, probable or definite.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I Subsection III, Art. 63 caput
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. Serious, unexpected events occurring in Brazil with possible, probable or definite causality to the investigational product.

rows.deadline: Fatal or life-threatening: 7 calendar days (Art. 66); others: 15 calendar days (Art. 67), from the sponsor's knowledge of the case.
rows.quote: Art. 63. O patrocinador deve notificar à Anvisa, por meio de formulário eletrônicoespecífico, os eventos adversos graves inesperados ocorridos no território nacional,cuja causalidade seja possível, provável ou definida em relação ao produto sobinvestigação.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I Subsection III, Art. 63 caput
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve notificar" = Mandatory; actor explicit; deadlines taken from Arts. 66-67 of the same text. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 63. The sponsor must notify Anvisa, by means of a specific electronic form, of unexpected serious adverse events occurring in national territory whose causality is possible, probable or definite in relation to the investigational product.

f.title: Keep detailed records of investigator-reported adverse events available to Anvisa
f.statement: The sponsor must keep detailed records of all adverse events reported by investigators; Anvisa may request them at any time.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I Subsection III, Art. 63 sole paragraph
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Clinical safety monitoring

rows.quote: Parágrafo único. O patrocinador deve manter todos os registros detalhados dos eventosadversos relatados pelos investigadores. A Anvisa poderá solicitar tais registros aqualquer momento.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I Subsection III, Art. 63 sole paragraph
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve manter" = Mandatory; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Sole paragraph. The sponsor must keep all detailed records of the adverse events reported by the investigators. Anvisa may request such records at any time.

f.title: Inform investigators of SUSARs, update the Investigator's Brochure and reassess benefit-risk
f.statement: The sponsor must inform the investigators involved in the trial of unexpected serious adverse events with possible, probable or definite causality, adopt procedures to update the Investigator's Brochure, and reassess the risks and benefits for participants.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I Subsection III, Art. 64
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Benefit–risk review; Safety communications

rows.quote: Art. 64. O patrocinador deve informar aos investigadores envolvidos no ensaio clínicosobre os eventos adversos graves inesperados, cuja causalidade seja possível, provávelou definida, e adotar os procedimentos para atualização da brochura do investigador,além de reavaliar os riscos e benefícios para os participantes.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I Subsection III, Art. 64
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve informar" = Mandatory; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 64. The sponsor must inform the investigators involved in the clinical trial of unexpected serious adverse events whose causality is possible, probable or definite, and adopt the procedures for updating the investigator's brochure, as well as reassess the risks and benefits for the participants.

f.title: Investigator reports serious adverse events to the sponsor within 24 hours
f.statement: The investigator must inform the sponsor of serious adverse events within 24 hours from the date of knowledge of the event.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I Subsection IV, Art. 65
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.deadline: Within 24 hours from the date of knowledge of the event
rows.quote: Art. 65. O investigador deve informar ao patrocinador sobre os eventos adversos gravesno prazo de até 24 (vinte e quatro) horas a contar da data de conhecimento do evento.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I Subsection IV, Art. 65
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 24 hours from the date of the investigator's knowledge. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve informar ... 24 horas" = Mandatory; actor and clock start explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 65. The investigator must inform the sponsor of serious adverse events within up to 24 (twenty-four) hours from the date of knowledge of the event.

f.title: Report fatal or life-threatening SUSARs within 7 calendar days; add follow-up within 8 days
f.statement: The sponsor must ensure that all relevant information on Art. 63 events (SUSARs in Brazil) that are fatal or life-threatening is documented and notified to Anvisa through the electronic form within at most 7 calendar days from the sponsor's knowledge of the case. Complementary follow-up information must be added to the form within 8 calendar days from the date of notification.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I Subsection IV, Art. 66
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. Fatal or life-threatening SUSARs occurring in Brazil (Art. 63).

rows.deadline: Initial: within 7 calendar days from the sponsor's knowledge of the case; follow-up: within 8 calendar days from the date of notification
rows.quote:
Art. 66. O patrocinador deve garantir que todas as informações relevantes sobreeventos adversos citados no Art. 63 que sejam fatais ou que ameacem a vida sejamdocumentados e notificados à Anvisa, por meio de formulário eletrônico, em no máximo 7(sete) dias corridos a contar da data de conhecimento do caso pelo patrocinador.
 Parágrafo único. As informações complementares sobre o acompanhamento dos eventosadversos mencionados no caput devem ser incluídas no formulário em até 8 (oito) diascorridos a contar da data de notificação.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I Subsection IV, Art. 66
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 7 calendar days from the date of the sponsor's knowledge of the case; follow-up within 8 calendar days counted from the date of notification. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve garantir ... 7 dias corridos", follow-up 8 days = Mandatory; actor and clock start explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 66. The sponsor must ensure that all relevant information on the adverse events referred to in Art. 63 that are fatal or life-threatening is documented and notified to Anvisa, by means of an electronic form, within a maximum of 7 (seven) calendar days from the date of knowledge of the case by the sponsor.
Sole paragraph. Complementary information on the follow-up of the adverse events mentioned in the caput must be included in the form within up to 8 (eight) calendar days from the date of notification.

f.title: Report all other SUSARs within 15 calendar days
f.statement: All other serious unexpected adverse events with possible, probable or definite causality to the investigational products must be notified to Anvisa within 15 calendar days from the sponsor's knowledge of the case.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section I Subsection IV, Art. 67
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. SUSARs that are not fatal or life-threatening.

rows.deadline: Within 15 calendar days from the sponsor's knowledge of the case
rows.quote: Art. 67. Todos os outros eventos adversos que sejam graves inesperados, cujacausalidade seja possível, provável ou definida em relação aos produtos sobinvestigação devem ser notificados à Anvisa em até 15 (quinze) dias corridos a contardo conhecimento do caso pelo patrocinador.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section I Subsection IV, Art. 67
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 15 calendar days from sponsor knowledge. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "devem ser notificados" passive, actor inferred; 15 calendar days correct. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 67. All other adverse events that are serious and unexpected, whose causality is possible, probable or definite in relation to the investigational products, must be notified to Anvisa within up to 15 (fifteen) calendar days from knowledge of the case by the sponsor.

f.title: Submit annual protocol follow-up reports with all adverse events per Brazilian site
f.statement: The sponsor must send Anvisa annual follow-up reports for each clinical trial protocol, in tabulated form and exclusively from Brazilian sites, containing title, protocol code, recruitment status, participants recruited per site, protocol deviations and violations per site, and a description of all adverse events per site in the period, identifying participants by their Case Report Form codes.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section II Subsection I, Art. 68 caput and VI

rows.location: Chapter VII Section II Subsection I, Art. 68 caput and VI
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve enviar" = Mandatory; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.

f.title: File the annual protocol report as a secondary petition within 60 calendar days
f.statement: The annual protocol follow-up report must be submitted as a secondary petition attached to the respective protocol process, within at most 60 calendar days, taking the clinical trial start date in Brazil as the anniversary reference.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section II Subsection I, Art. 68 §§1-2

rows.deadline: Within 60 calendar days; annual reference = clinical trial start date in Brazil
rows.quote:
§1º O relatório anual de acompanhamento de protocolo de ensaio clínico deve sersubmetido à Anvisa na forma de petição secundária anexada ao processo do respectivoprotocolo ao qual está vinculado.
 §2º O relatório anual deve ser protocolizado no prazo máximo de 60 (sessenta) diascorridos tendo como referência de anualidade a data de início do ensaio clínico noBrasil.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section II Subsection I, Art. 68 §§1-2
data_elements: clinical trial start date in Brazil
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve ser submetido/protocolizado" passive, actor inferred; 60 days correct. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
§ 1 The annual clinical trial protocol follow-up report must be submitted to Anvisa as a secondary petition attached to the process of the respective protocol to which it is linked.
§ 2 The annual report must be filed within a maximum of 60 (sixty) calendar days, taking as the annual reference the start date of the clinical trial in Brazil.

f.title: Final trial report must list all adverse events and lab abnormalities with causality per participant
f.statement: The final report the sponsor submits after completion of the trial in all participating countries must include a list of all adverse events and laboratory abnormalities, with causality assessment, occurring per participant.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section II Subsection I, Art. 69 VIII
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by RDC 945/2024. Final report under Art. 69, due after completion of the trial in all participating countries.

rows.deadline: Final report within 12 months of the clinical trial end date (Art. 69 §2)
rows.quote: VIII- relação de todos os eventos adversos e anormalidades laboratoriais comavaliação de causalidade ocorridas por participantes;
rows.location: Chapter VII Section II Subsection I, Art. 69 VIII
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; list item VIII without the Art. 69 lead-in; actor inferred. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: VIII - list of all adverse events and laboratory abnormalities, with causality assessment, occurring per participant;

f.title: File the final trial report within 12 months of the trial end date
f.statement: The final clinical trial report must be filed within 12 months of the clinical trial end date.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section II Subsection I, Art. 69 §2

rows.deadline: Within 12 months of the clinical trial end date
rows.quote: §2º O relatório final deve ser protocolizado em até 12 (doze) meses da data detérmino do ensaio clínico.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section II Subsection I, Art. 69 §2
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve ser protocolizado" passive, actor inferred; 12 months correct. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: § 2 The final report must be filed within up to 12 (twelve) months of the end date of the clinical trial.

f.title: Submit the DSUR annually within 60 calendar days of the reference date
f.statement: The sponsor must send Anvisa development safety update reports (DSURs) for the investigational medicinal product annually, filed within at most 60 calendar days, taking as the anniversary reference the date of Anvisa's DDCM approval or the date set in the international development.
f.clause: Chapter VII Section II Subsection II, Art. 70

rows.deadline: Annually, within 60 calendar days; reference = DDCM approval date by Anvisa or the date determined in the international development
rows.quote:
Art. 70. O patrocinador deve enviar anualmente à Anvisa relatórios de atualizaçãode segurança do desenvolvimento do medicamento experimental.
 Parágrafo único. Os relatórios anuais devem ser protocolizados no prazo máximo de60 (sessenta) dias corridos tendo como referência de anualidade a data de aprovação doDDCM pela Anvisa ou a data determinada no desenvolvimento internacional.
rows.location: Chapter VII Section II Subsection II, Art. 70
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (superseded by RDC 945/2024); quote matches the captured text; "deve enviar anualmente", 60 days = Mandatory; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 70. The sponsor must send Anvisa annually development safety update reports of the investigational medicinal product.
Sole paragraph. The annual reports must be filed within a maximum of 60 (sixty) calendar days, taking as the annual reference the date of approval of the DDCM by Anvisa or the date determined in the international development.
